{{ConsumableInfobox |image-static = MolotovIcon.png |image-dynamic = MolotovDynamic.png |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |type = Offensive
Support |cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Cooldown]]25 |initial_cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Initial Cooldown]]15 |use_limit = 5 |usable_in = PVE }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Throw a molotov grenade at a position that applies burn for 6 seconds|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molotov''' is one of the four common [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''Molotov''' has a 16.67% (6.76% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 9.23% (8.82% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be obtained from a [[Mid Grade Crate]]. Only up to five '''Molotovs''' can be used in a match. It has a 25 second cooldown, though when the match first starts, the cooldown is reduced to 15 seconds. ==Usage== When using the '''Molotov''', your avatar's right hand will hold a Molotov cocktail, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the Molotov cocktail will be thrown. This will make it create a 6.5 stud radius puddle of fire, setting any enemy that enters it on fire. This wall of fire lasts for 10 seconds. Enemies will be set on fire for 6 seconds, receiving 10 damage every 0.5 seconds (12 DPS), dealing 96 damage in total. It will also drop their defense by 15% every tick. It can only drop up to 50% of the enemy's defense. As it drops it through fire, any other fire based defense dropping, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Napalm Strike]], will not stack with it. ==Appearance== The '''Molotov''' is a translucent green colored glass bottle with a blank label. It has a piece of cloth wick sticking out of the bottle's mouth, which is used to set the '''Molotov''' on fire. ==Strategy== *The '''Molotov''' is best used against large numbers of fast enemies such as the [[Glitch]]. Throwing it in front of the enemies will allow the '''Molotov''' to set fire to several enemies before the fire disappears. *The '''Molotov''' can be effective in reducing the defense of enemies with high defense such as the [[Fallen Guardian]] if defense dropping towers are not placed down. *It is worth noting that the '''Molotov''' can bounce off the path, which can make it unreliable. **To maximize the chances of the '''Molotov''' hitting, it is recommended to face the same direction as the path. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Props}} ConsumablePropMolotov.png|Molotov }} ==Update History== *'''10 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0]] **'''Molotov''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Molotov''' does not play sounds when equipped. **{{Bug}} Wall of fire can be collided with. ** {{Bug}} If a player tries to equip the '''Molotov''' from the intermission lobbies, it will only be equipped once the match starts. *'''11 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0|v1.21.5]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Molotov''' now plays sounds when equipped. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **{{Bug}} Damage no longer generates cash in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and special maps. *'''11 September 2024''' - [[v1.31.0]] **Rarity changed from {{Color|Uncommon}} to {{Color|Common}}. *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **Burn no longer prevents enemies from being frozen. *'''18 September 2026 -''' [[v2.11.0]] **Flame size increased from 4 to 6.5. **Burn damage increased from 8 to 10. {{ConsumableNavBox}}
